reviews_5s:
Slim, non-intrusive, accurate, easy to use. Perfect for my packages to get mailing weights. Perfect little scale.I like it! Responds fast and is accurate. A good little scale for the price. I weigh my food track calories accurately and this does the job!Works great and looks great in my kitchenThis blue scale has found a nice spot on my kitchen counter. I find the LED display very clear and bright. It gives me consistent readings when I'm portioning ingredients for baking, and I like that it can handle a good amount of weight. Plus, it came with batteries, which meant I could start using it straight out of the box.This is a very lightweight digital scale. I weigh flours and other ingredients when cooking and my old scale quit working after 7 years of use. I am struggling with switching to something new, but the scale seems to work well. I don't like the matt texture of the surface (my old one had glass) but it is a lot lighter to carry around the kitchen. The controls are easy to work and it tares well. So far, my baked goods are working like they should, so the scale must be relatively accurate. I am happy with it, but I do miss my old one. Oh, and this one came with batteries which was great because I didn't have any when I opened and first used this.Many recipes call for specific measurements either in ounces or in grams and it's important to follow the recipes to a T. I needed a quality lightweight accurate small scale to measure my ingredients, and I found this portable scale and found it to be perfect.

It's lightweight, battery powered and digital and measures approximately 7 inches by 6 inches. I have found it to be accurate and it utilizes a tare system which I like.

It is very helpful as I cook assorted recipes.The scale works well for my coffee and my sourdough starter. It went through a time at the beginning where it would freeze and not respond to anything. It seeming works better now, so that’s good.This is a nifty compact, lightweight kitchen scale,

The scale is easy to use and set Tare Weight, and it has another button to alternate between measurement units (grams, kilograms, ounces, pounds). The buttons are touch-sensitive, so no pressure is required.

It runs on three AAA batteries (included).

I do not have another similar scale with which to make comparisons about its accuracy, but it certainly is sensitive.
I gently laid the paper pamphlet that came with it onto the scale and it gave a reading; I wasn't even expecting that.This scale is compact, thin and light, doesn’t take up much room so is easy to store. The display is clear and easy to read. Basically as described, works as you would expect and the price is reasonable.Nicely sized. Easy to use this scale for anything from a single apple to measuring a large cake mix. Seems pretty accurate. I love that it runs one batteries makes it easy to use anywhere in the kitchen.
